joints.name: Wing panel root <-> saddle root plates (LE locating pin + TE tab screw)
joints.notes: Panel slides outboard-to-inboard on the joiner, root plates meet at z = +/-0.080. NOT in the CAD: nothing retains the panel along the joiner (Wing_Bolt sits at z = +/-0.065, inside the saddle). This joint is the proposed fix: saddle plate carries a 25 mm tab that enters a slot in the panel, one vertical M3 screw per side clamps it; a head-pin on the LE stops rotation. est.

joints.name: Wing saddle <-> pod: M5 Wing_Bolt + washer + captive nut (shop joint)
joints.notes: Matches CAD part Wing_Bolt: M5x30 button head, head underside at y=0.01451 (upper surface at 70 % chord), shaft down to y=-0.01549, z=+/-0.065. Nut sits in a PETG hard-point plate on the pod top, below the saddle underside (y=-0.0073). The CAD Wing_Bolt is the same physical screw: model once.

joints.name: Joiner <-> saddle bore and spar sockets (bonded)
joints.notes: Joiner 0.76 m (z -0.38..+0.38) epoxied into the saddle bore (0.23 mm diametral clearance, cad/BuildVtol.cs WingSaddle); panels slide on the free ends; Spar_Tube sockets are bonded into the panels. No screws. The M3 front-clamp screws (J-04) pass through the Spar_Tube at z=+/-0.417 and 0.450, which is 37 mm outboard of the joiner end (0.38), so they do not touch the joiner.

joints.name: Front boom clamp <-> wing (2 vertical M3x40 through the spar socket) per boom
joints.notes: Bolts at x=-0.0716 (spar axis), z=+/-0.01635 either side of the boom, from the upper skin down through foam, both walls of the hollow spar socket (joiner ends at z=0.38), foam, into M3 inserts at the clamp top (y=-0.01343). Engagement only about 3.4 mm: marginal; M3x50 316 SS gives 7 mm for $17.39/50 (see schedule). Clamp upper half stays on the wing for transport.

joints.name: Rear boom clamp <-> wing (2 vertical M3x30 through foam) per boom
joints.notes: Bolts at x=-0.19094, z=+/-0.01635 about the boom, through 15.9 mm foam into inserts at clamp top y=-0.00517. Foam-only attachment of a clamp that reacts about 110 N couple (see schedule): large washers + epoxy; flagged.

joints.name: Boom clamp lower halves <-> upper halves (boom drops out for transport)
joints.notes: Clamp assumed split in the plane y=-0.03 (boom axis); CAD part is a single block with a bore. 4 M3x20 per clamp, from below (head in 4 mm counterbore) into inserts in the upper half. Bore printed 25.4 + 0.2 and clamps down onto the tube. 16 bolts total: the main field-assembly time cost (R5).

joints.name: Boom front <-> rear stub splice (internal plug + 2 cross bolts per boom)
joints.notes: CAD overlaps Boom_Front (ends x=-0.53458) and the stub (starts x=-0.47448) by 60 mm: two same-OD tubes cannot overlap, so the real joint is a butt joint at x=-0.50458 (the rear Motor_Mount centre) with an internal printed PA6-CF plug 23.2 dia x 150 long (boom ID 23.622). The 0.154 m joiner offcut gives only ONE aluminium insert, so a printed plug is assumed (est). Two M3x30 cross bolts per boom at +/-0.050 m, outside the 70 mm mount.
joints.source: cad/params.txt comp=Boom_Front, Boom_Rear_Stub; docs/research/budget-airframe.md; inventory.json P-32 (0.76 of 0.914 m used)

joints.name: Motor mount clamshell <-> boom (4 pinch bolts per mount)
joints.notes: Mount modelled as a single block 70 x 46 x 36; assumed split at the boom axis (y=-0.03). Lower half (15 mm) bolts up into inserts in the upper half (21 mm, carries the motor). Pinch bolts at dx=+/-16, dz=+/-17.85 mm. Front mount at x=0.37092 (boom end at 0.42042); rear mount sits over the splice (J-07).

joints.name: Lift motor <-> motor mount (4 x M3x12 from the bore side)
joints.notes: Motor base at y=-0.009 (= mount top). X4110S bolt pattern is NOT published on any page read: 4 x M3 on a 19 mm square is a PLACEHOLDER (est). Boom top (y=-0.0173) lies under the pattern, so screws go in from the bore side: head + washer sit in a 6.0 dia x 4.5 mm pocket in the bore ceiling, mount and motor are assembled off the boom, then the boom is slid/laid in. Engagement 3.43 mm vs CAD base thickness 4.0 mm (EST).

joints.name: Lift prop adapter + holding plate + 4 screws (supplied with X4110S)
joints.notes: Bolt-on adapter, holding plate and screws come with the motor (readymaderc X4110S page). Dimensions, hole pattern and screw size are not published: all geometry here is est. Prop hub in CAD (y 0.0202..0.0378) overlaps the motor top (0.023..0.041) by 2.8 mm; adapter sandwiches the hub (adapter y 0.023..0.029, hub 0.029..0.0378, plate 0.0378..0.0398).

joints.name: Pusher motor <-> firewall <-> pod aft bulkhead
joints.notes: No pusher mount exists in the CAD (motor base at x=-0.400 is the pod end). Added: PA6-CF firewall 58 dia x 6.1 mm at x -0.400..-0.3939 (forward of the motor face), PETG aft bulkhead 58 dia x 6.5 mm at x -0.3939..-0.3874 carrying 4 M3 inserts. Motor screws M3x10 from the forward face (engagement 3.4 mm, same placeholder pattern as J-09); firewall screws M3x12 from the aft face at r=26 mm, outside the motor flange (R 22.1) and bell (R 24).
joints.source: cad/params.txt comp=Pusher_Motor, Fuselage_Pod; cad/BuildVtol.cs Fuselage (pod ends at x=-0.40, tail radius 0.03)

joints.name: Pusher prop adapter, APC 14x8.5E prop, spinner
joints.notes: Same supplied adapter/plate/screws as J-10, axis -X. APC prop bore 6.35 mm (budget-lift.md) vs 4 mm shaft: ring adapter not budgeted (—). Spinner (CAD base x=-0.442, cone to -0.480) is not in the BOM and has no stated mounting: 3 x M3x10 into the holding plate assumed (est).

joints.name: Gear clamp cap <-> gear clamp body on the boom (2 screws per clamp)
joints.notes: Gear_Clamp spans y -0.0587..-0.0133 around the boom. Assumed split at y=-0.03: cap (top) held by 2 M3x20 from above into inserts in the lower half (dz=+/-16.35, clear of the leg which is 25.4 dia). Counterbore 4 mm in the cap top. || rev2: cap screws M3x20 with ISO 7089 M3 washers under the heads on the printed cap, inserts bore 4.2 x 7.5 (cad_mm). Clamp bore 25.0 (cad) on a 25.4 tube. Leg cross bolt uses the same washer and nyloc stack (HW-050..052).

joints.name: Landing leg <-> gear clamp and axle block (M3x40 cross bolts + nyloc)
joints.notes: Leg top (y=-0.0387) overlaps the boom bottom wall by 4 mm in the CAD (leg is 20 mm inside the clamp): real leg stops at y=-0.0427 (modelling artefact, flag). Cross bolt along X through clamp walls and leg tube (holes drilled in the 1.47 mm tube wall) at y=-0.0487. Axle block (replaces the dome foot) is bonded and cross-bolted 12 mm above the leg end. Block foot is 16 mm wide so the axle is 10 mm below the tube end (electrical-architecture.md 11). || rev2: leg seats in a 26.0 bore (cad) axle block, OD 32.0. Cross bolt M3x40 at 12 mm above the tube end, washer each side, nyloc on the rear face (3.0 mm thread left). Clamp roll moment on the gear clamp rises with the 29.2 mm axle offset (open risk, see mechanisms.json gear.risks).

joints.name: Wheel, axle, collar (Du-Bro 300SL / DUB248 / DUB140)
joints.tool: 1/16 in hex key (collar set screw) + 7 mm spanner (est)
joints.notes: Du-Bro 300SL: 76.2 dia x 23.0 wide, 4 mm bore; DUB248 axle 4.0 x 50.8 mm (thread not published); DUB140 collar bore 3.97, OD 8.8, w 5.6, 6-32 set screw. Stack from the block inner face outboard: nyloc (est 5) | block foot 16 | M4 washer 0.8 | wheel 23.0 | collar 5.6 | axle end 0.4 beyond the collar (axle runs from 13 mm inboard of the foot to 37.8 mm outboard of the leg axis = 50.8). Wheel outboard of the boom so the 76 mm wheel clears the leg tube. Ground y=-0.2918 (wheel bottom) as in section 11. || rev2: offset single-sided axle. Stack from the block inner face (u mm from the leg axis): nyloc -1.7..3.3, foot 3.3..11.3, inner collar 11.3..16.9 (set screw radial +x), M4 washer 16.9..17.7, wheel 17.7..40.7, M4 washer 40.7..41.5, outer collar 41.5..47.1 (set screw up). Axle -2.7..48.1 (50.8). Wheel centre u 29.2 mm. Wheel bore and hub width not published (-).

joints.name: Tail: fin and H_Tail seat on boom stubs; servo saddles; H_Tail screws
joints.notes: Fins bonded to the stub top (root y=-0.0173, tangent) with foam-safe glue/epoxy: permanent. H_Tail (0.893 m span) must come off for R4 (largest piece <= 0.5 m in one direction): 2 M3x12 per side through the foam into inserts in the printed saddle cheek (z=+/-0.4145, beside the boom). Saddles epoxied to the stub and held by 2 zip ties each, placed ahead of the H_Tail leading edge (x=-0.7705) or behind the fin trailing edge (x=-0.9208) so they do not pass through the fin root. Left boom gets an elevator-less H_Tail seat saddle of the same print.

joints.name: Aileron servo <-> servo tray (R and L), arm
joints.tool: 1.3 mm hex key (M2 button), arm screw driver (est)
joints.notes: EMAX ES3005HV: body L 38.6 (ear direction, along X), W 18.8 (along Y), H 34.9 (along the shaft, spanwise Z). Ear hole spacing and ear thickness are NOT on any page read: 48 mm centres, +/-5 mm across, ears 2.5 mm thick and 6 mm below the shaft end are est (typical standard-size servo). Shaft outboard, ears outboard of a 3 mm PETG tray bonded into the wing; M2x8 from the ear side into a captive M2 nut in the tray pocket. Servo mid at x=-0.12, shaft 9.6 mm aft at x=-0.1296 (est). || rev2: servo case/ears/spline defined (HW-129). Ears M3x12 + M3 washers + nyloc DIN 985 (HW-064/065/066). Arm: 23T, hole radius 20 mm, trimmed to 25. Leads tied through the tray slot (HW-134).

joints.name: Elevator servo (right stub) <-> saddle tray, arm
joints.notes: Servo at x=-0.79, z=0.40: shaft along Z pointing inboard, so the arm clears the boom (inboard face z=0.4210; servo body z 0.3825..0.4175). A single servo drives the 0.855 m elevator through the foam (no torque rod): flag. || rev2: elevator servo in printed bay HW-132; M3x12 ear screws; arm hole 14 mm, trimmed 18; lead tie HW-135.

joints.name: Rudder servos <-> saddle tray, arms
joints.notes: Servo at x=-0.85, z=+/-0.4116, shaft along +Y (hinge axis is vertical). Envelope touches the boom inboard face (z 0.4210) and its top (y=-0.0126) intrudes about 2.5 mm into the elevator underside (x -0.8234..-0.8461, y bottom -0.0151): flag, lower by 3 mm. Arm plane y=-0.01055. || rev2: rudder servos in bays HW-133; M3x12 ear screws; arm hole 14 mm, trimmed 18; lead tie HW-136. Servo positions moved from the first placement (placement_changes in mechanisms.json).

joints.name: Aileron control horn, backing plate, clevis, pushrod (R and L)
joints.notes: Horn on the aileron LOWER skin at x=-0.200, hole 14 mm below the skin; servo arm 20 mm pointing down through a slot in the lower skin. Pushrod lies in the plane z=+/-0.8195. DUB230 12 in rod cut to length; Z-bend at the servo arm, Kwik-Link at the horn; heat-shrink keeper on the Z-bend. Geometry in schedule section 4. || rev2: horn at x=-0.195 (was -0.200/-0.186), hole 14 mm, 2 x M2x20 with backing plate and M2 nuts, foam thickness 14.52 mm, protrusion 0.38 mm. Pushrod Z-bend to Kwik-Link, keeper bead.

joints.name: Elevator control horn, backing plate, clevis, pushrod
joints.notes: Horn on elevator lower skin x=-0.832, z=0.37955 (right). Elevator is 2-3 mm thick here: M2x8 + backing plate + nut stack 6.5 mm. || rev2: elevator horn x=-0.8354, hole 18 mm, 2 x M2x8, foam 2.13 mm, protrusion 0.77 mm.

joints.name: Rudder control horns, backing plates, clevis, pushrods (L and R)
joints.notes: Fin has no rudder surface in the CAD (single lofted solid): rudder hinge x=-0.8757 (70 % chord) and horn at x=-0.895 on the INBOARD fin face (est). Arm in plane y=-0.01055. || rev2: rudder horns on the inboard fin face at x=-0.8925, hole 14 mm, 2 x M2x12 per horn, foam 5.5 mm, protrusion 1.4 mm. Rudder surface is not in the CAD: rudder gap 4.0 mm est.

joints.name: Control-surface hinges (tape): ailerons x2, elevator
joints.notes: Hinge tape on the upper surface across the 2 % chord gap; 1 in tape (kit item 9). Tape thickness not on the page (—). || rev2: tape strips defined with length, gap and side (HW-100 instances): aileron 4.77 mm gap, 612 mm each; elevator 3.5 mm gap, 855.4 mm; rudders 4.0 mm gap (est), 188 mm, tape on the outboard face. TE-down deflection limited by gap closure to about 14.7 deg at the aileron unless the lower edges are chamfered.

joints.name: Canopy <-> pod hatch rim (4 screws)
joints.notes: Canopy flange screws at x=0.10 and 0.30, z=+/-0.040 (outside the blister radius 0.035 at both ends), M3x10 into inserts in a hatch rim plate flush with the pod surface (pod radius at z=0.04 from cad/BuildVtol.cs Fuselage()). Hatch rim not in the CAD (est).

joints.name: Pod formers, battery tray, straps
joints.notes: Three PETG formers (x=-0.025, 0.150, 0.345; OD 140/140/112) are epoxied into the XPS pod shell (CAD says "XPS shell on printed PETG frames", positions est). Tray 171 x 60 x 3 with 8 mm end blocks (4 M3 inserts) sits between PF_A and PF_B under the battery (y -0.078..-0.075); straps at x=0.02, 0.10. Battery box x -0.0165..0.1385, y -0.075..-0.025, z +/-0.024 (cad/BuildVtol.cs RoundBox).

joints.name: FC stack on avionics deck; deck on formers
joints.notes: Deck PETG 195 x 90 x 2 at y -0.0165..-0.0145 between PF_B and PF_C with 8 mm end blocks (4 inserts). FC stack 52 x 32 x 17 on the 30.5 x 30.5 pattern (listing "30x30, Custom"; hole diameter and board outline not on any page read): 4 M3x30 from under the deck through 6 mm spacers and the stack, nyloc on top (6 + 17 + 4 + 2 = 29).

joints.name: GPS mast on canopy and GPS on mast
joints.notes: Mast 10 dia x 14 printed PETG on canopy top (y=0.070), GPS 21 x 21 x 8 at y 0.084..0.092 (components.json GPS1 y=0.088). Canopy wall 2.5 mm (est). M2 screws self-tap into 1.6 dia pilots; PCB hole pattern not on any page (—), est 17 mm. Keep steel screws >= 15 mm from the compass chip: use nylon M2 (kit add-on 3b) if the compass calibration fails.

joints.name: RX, Remote ID, UBEC, BUS1, XT90S, airspeed module: cable-tie mounts
joints.notes: One 8 in tie each (XT90S two) through slots in the canopy/deck/tray plus double-sided foam tape (tape not costed, —). Positions from components.json placements (est).

joints.name: ESC mounting: lift ESCs on boom outboard faces, pusher ESC
joints.notes: ESC (45 x 25 x 8 est) outboard of the boom (boom outer z=0.4464, ESC z 0.4487..0.4567): two ties around boom + ESC at x=+/-0.012 from the ESC centre; ESC_P two ties to a pod former slot (est).

joints.name: Harness joint boxes J1/J2/J3 anchors (XT60H + JR pairs)
joints.notes: One tie per connector pair anchors the plugs to the structure so they take no cable load (R4 breakdown at saddle z=+/-0.08, rear clamp, splice). Connector bodies are not modelled as fasteners.

joints.name: Pitot clamp on left wing lower skin
joints.notes: Pitot 6 dia x 250 at y=-0.02, x -0.05..+0.20, z=-1.0. Printed post (22 x 14 x 16) epoxied to the lower skin at x=-0.035 (skin y=-0.0128, post top at the skin, split at the pitot axis) with a cap on the inboard (+z) side; 2 horizontal M3x12 at x=-0.035+/-0.007 into inserts in the outboard half. 7 mm from the rear end of the tube: est.
